summary: Iteration 80 — Spanish (ES) support. BACKEND (11/11 pytest passed): POST /api/recipes/bundle-checkout accepts lang and persists it (verified in Mongo payment_transactions: es/de/en/it + invalid lang falls back to it), invalid bundle -> 400, unauth -> 401; GET /api/recipes?collection=mikilab (admin) returns 94 recipes with name_es/procedure_es populated on 100% and notes_es/flour_type_es populated wherever the IT source exists, and 0 recipes have procedure_es == procedure (i.e. really translated); GET /api/shop/products returns name_es/desc_es/allergens_es on all 5 products (no _id leak); /api/community/posts reachable for a normal (non-PRO) user. FRONTEND (localStorage mikilab_lang=es): bottom nav = Inicio/Recetas/Tu Laboratorio/Aprende/Comunidad, ES persists across reload, IT/DE/EN regression OK (nav + recipe category folders localized in all 4 langs). Recipe detail as admin renders Spanish name, INGREDIENTES (Harina/Agua/Masa madre sólida/Malta de cebada) and PROCEDIMIENTO fully in Spanish. Shop shows ES product names/descriptions; clicking shop-bundle-pane fires POST /api/recipes/bundle-checkout and redirects to Stripe Checkout, and the created session was stored with lang='es' (session cs_live_a1NV1kC8...). Community page is fully ES and NOT paywalled. Main gap found: large parts of the UI still fall back to Italian or English when lang=es because 46 files define a LOCAL tri(i,d,e) helper with no ES argument.

minor.issue: Stripe is running with LIVE keys in the preview env (sessions are cs_live_...). Test clicks create real live checkout sessions — consider test keys for preview.

critical_code_review_comments: i18n architecture smell: two different fallback strategies coexist (global tri: es->en->it; 46 local tri helpers: es->it). Any new language will silently regress again — delete the local helpers.
server.py is 4419 lines — split payments/recipes/shop routers into modules.
_r_field/bundle PDF ES path is correct (es -> _es -> _en -> it), and lang is persisted both in Stripe metadata and payment_transactions, so webhook fulfilment will use the buyer language.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is NOT forced at boot anymore: open the app, click [data-testid='login-btn'], then fill auth-email/auth-password and auth-submit. Set language with page.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('mikilab_lang','es')"), or click [data-testid='lang-es']. Recipes are behind category folders: click [data-testid^='cat-folder-'] then [data-testid^='recipe-row-']. Shop is reached from Home via [data-testid='home-core-corsi'] and bundle purchase is [data-testid^='shop-bundle-'] (redirects to LIVE Stripe checkout — avoid clicking repeatedly). Lab tour overlay can be suppressed with localStorage 'mikilab_lab_tour_v1'='1'. Backend regression suite for ES: /app/backend/tests/test_iter80_es.py (run with `pytest tests/test_iter80_es.py` from /app/backend).
rca_of_the_issue: The P0 bug (bundle PDF/email language) is FIXED end-to-end: frontend Shop.buyBundle sends the active lang, bundle_checkout whitelists it/de/en/es, stores it in Stripe metadata and in payment_transactions, and the webhook passes meta['lang'] to _bundle_fulfill; _r_field/_build_bundle_pdf resolve _es fields with es->en->it fallback. The remaining ES defects are purely presentational and all trace to one root cause: 46 components declare their own tri(i,d,e) helper that ignores the 'es' branch, so ES falls back to Italian there, while components using the global LanguageContext tri correctly fall back es->en->it.
